jobs.title: Area Leader of Marketing
jobs.description:
At Raising Cane’s Chicken Fingers®, we serve only the most Craveable Chicken Finger Meals® — it’s our ONE LOVE®. What began as a dream by our Owner and Founder, Todd Graves, has grown into one of the fastest-growing chicken concepts, with over 1,000 Restaurants worldwide. Known for our great Crew and cool Culture, we live by a Work Hard, Have Fun philosophy. As we continue to grow across the U.S. and internationally, including Restaurants in the U.K. and Mexico, every Crewmember plays an important role in our success. Now is your chance to join the team and help establish Cane’s in the U.K!

**Job Description**

**Your Role at Raising Cane’s:**

The Area Leader of Marketing (ALM) is responsible for all marketing efforts that support restaurants within the area. This includes managing, planning and overseeing promotions, advertising campaigns of Restaurant services and products, conducting market research, expanding our business, planning and preparing projects, negotiating contracts, leveraging expert knowledge of the market, staying on top of changing market dynamics, using market expertise to identify traffic drivers within each restaurant trade area, and creating and executing market and Restaurant-level marketing plans. The ALM must remain nimble, constantly looking for ways to keep the brand top of mind. This role is also responsible for leading the planning, negotiation, and execution of sponsorships that support their market. Additionally, this role directly supports each restaurant with day-to-day branding and marketing needs, always working in collaboration and alignment with the Business Unit (BU) team.

**Your Impact and Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with Raising Cane’s by acting as the market expert, staying informed about market demographics, traffic drivers, competition, and other market dynamics impacting sales and apply this knowledge to restaurant and market-level marketing plans
* Serve as brand ambassador within the market, being primary contact for community relationships and partnerships
* Connect with the community, build relationships with partners, promote Raising Cane’s, and support restaurants
* Lead on- and off-site market-level activities that support the brand and local community
* Oversee planning and execution of active community involvement through local community outreach, requests submitted through the community request system and surveys and Customer feedback
* Create and execute market and restaurant-level marketing plans annually, with quarterly re-evaluations
* Lead New Restaurant Opening (NRO) marketing planning and execution, including developing marketing plans, pre-canvassing activities, on-site support of pre-opening and opening activities, and post-opening marketing support
* Manage all aspects of the sponsorship process, including planning, negotiation, and partnership management, ensuring adherence to the approved sponsorship process and maximizing sponsorship benefits
* Directly support restaurants within the area with all marketing-related activities and questions, including defining target group for marketing campaigns
* Enforce Raising Cane’s brand standards and marketing philosophies within the restaurant and market
* Support activations and activities planned at the support office level as needed
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reports detailing the impact of marketing activities (including on sales) and related recommendations
* Provide feedback to the RSO on campaigns, programs, and tools

**Qualifications**

**Travel Requirements:**

* 80% Travel
* International travel passport required
* Required to live within assigned area

**Requirements for Success:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or communications or equivalent experience
* 3+ years’ field marketing experience in a multi-unit restaurant or retail environment
* Experience in planning and negotiating sponsorships, including establishing new relationships, negotiating contracts, managing relationships, implementing assets, and assessing impact
* Availability to work a variety of shifts, including days, evenings, and weekends
* Detail-oriented, organized, and flexible for effective multi-priority management
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work effectively and efficiently both independently and collaboratively
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint and Word)

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time and you must hold valid Right to Work in the UK when applying.

**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.
  
  
We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.
  
  
Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.
  
  
**Why Verda**

* Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits.
* 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.
* A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

**Your Responsibilities**

* Own Verda's editorial calendar and cadence end-to-end, spanning performance benchmarks, deployment guides, applied-research papers, customer stories, and product launches
* Ship content consistently against company-wide priorities
* Coordinate production across the internal AI Lab, AI Developer Advocates, wider Engineering and Marketing teams, and ecosystem partners
* Edit deeply technical content for clarity without distorting substance
* Write informational and narrative pieces directly
* Direct the SEO & GEO agency and external writers, integrating their input into the editorial plan
* Decide when to scale with additional agency or freelance support
* Hold a high bar for accepted work regardless of who produces it
* Partner closely with Product Marketing — owning the cadence and craft of how positioning shows up, while Product Marketing owns positioning itself
* Build the network of contributors that lets the editorial engine scale as the function matures

**Your key competencies**

* 5+ years in content marketing or editorial roles, with at least 3 years editing technical content for developer or research-grade audiences
* Strong editorial judgement — you know what's worth publishing, what needs another pass, and how to push work to a high bar
* Technical enough to fact-check, simplify without distorting, and earn the respect of the researchers and engineers whose work you're shaping
* A capable writer in your own right; you can shift between editing and writing without losing voice
* Strong cross-stakeholder coordination across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams
* Proficient in directing agencies and external contributors, with a clear bar for the quality of work you accept
* Experience with (or genuine curiosity about) GEO and how technical content earns citations from AI assistants

**Nice to have**

* Experience at cloud infrastructure, data platform, or developer tool product companies
* Familiarity with the AI developer community and the kinds of content that earn its attention and trust
* Have built networks of external contributors and/or ambassador or champion programs

 We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

 After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as  personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and  combine their pensions with us. 

 With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

 We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 *Due to high interest, we’ll close applications once we have enough candidates to move to the next stage. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible so you don’t miss out. 

 📍UK Remote | 💰£42,500 - £53,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits   ✨

 The Role 🚀 

 We’re hiring a Creator Marketing Executive at Monzo. We’re looking for a brilliant creator marketing expert to help us scale our next chapter: showing up less like a standard bank and more like an authoritative, high-craft media publisher.

You’ll support the end-to-end execution of creator campaigns, manage always-on creator relationships, and help build deep trust around the culture of money.

 If you are an energetic, detail-oriented creator marketer who loves collaborating with talent, knows how to drive real brand love, and can navigate the nuances of a regulated environment with strong judgment, we invite you to join our team.

 The Team 💫 

 You’ll join a tight-knit, collaborative social and creator team. You’ll report directly to our Head of Social and Influencer, with direct support from our Creator Marketing Manager.

 Monzo is growing up, and we’re ready for our next stage of growth. We’re moving away from the old playbook to build a high-quality, always-on social and creator ecosystem with partners at the top of their game. This role is a great opportunity to work with some of the best in the game, and bring a fresh perspective to creator marketing at Monzo.

 You’ll play a key role by… 

- Executing high-impact campaigns: Support and deliver always-on, reactive, and integrated creator campaigns on time and on budget.

- Driving trust & authority: Help shift brand perceptions and build long-term credibility through authentic creator partnerships and ambassador networks.

- Supporting creator content & craft: Collaborate closely with talent and agencies to co-create high-performing, platform-native content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Substack and more.

- Ensuring rigorous compliance: Act as a detailed guardian for brand alignment, risk, and regulatory guidelines across all creator output.

- Tracking & optimise performance: Monitor campaign KPIs, analyse performance data, and help translate insights into actionable creative strategy.

- Talent research and knowledge: Stay plugged into TikTok, Instagram, and wider internet culture to identify up-and-coming creators and social publishers who align with our brand values.

- Campaign & content Support: Assist in briefing, coordinating, and supporting creators through execution to ensure assets meet creative standards and deadlines.

- Creator management: Support talent onboarding and briefing, and day-to-day relationship management through our agency for our trusted ambassador roster.

- Delivering compliant content: Review creator-generated content thoroughly to ensure full compliance with internal risk and controls teams and industry regulations.

- Agency & cross-functional collaboration: Work seamlessly alongside agency partners, internal brand, writers, social, and growth teams to align creator work with commercial goals.

- Performance reporting: Track metrics, build reporting dashboards, and extract insights on media efficiency, brand lift, and engagement.

- Trend & competitor tracking: Monitor competitor activity and emerging platform features to bring fresh, innovative ideas to the table.

 We’d love to hear from you if… 

- You have 1–3 years’ experience in creator marketing, influencer partnerships or digital social media.

- You’re proactive and comfortable managing small projects independently, while knowing when to ask for guidance.

- You understand platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn, and what helps creator content stand out.

- You have a strong eye for detail and can stay organised when managing budgets, content deliverables and regulatory requirements.

- You’re a great communicator who can build trusting relationships with creators and collaborate with teams across the business.

- You’re comfortable using social analytics tools and keen to learn how creator storytelling contributes to business results.

- You bring good judgement and empathy to your work, balancing creative, culturally relevant ideas with sensitivity to financial topics and brand risks.

 Some nice to haves… 

- Prior experience coordinating creator events, activations, or ambassador programs.

- Understanding of social SEO, keyword optimisation, and search intent in creator content.

- Familiarity with creator management tools, social listening software, or analytics suites.

jobs.title: Demand Marketing Lead, UK
jobs.description:
**Building the marketing department for the future**
Marketing at Euromonitor is being reimagined. We're building an AI-powered growth engine: agentic, automated, and data and tech led. A B2B marketing system designed for 2030, not 2015.
  
  
Behind it sits an advantage most companies would envy: original research from analysts across 210 markets, and decades of proprietary data built over more than 50 years. Our job is to turn that into growth.
  
  
And not incremental growth. We're not here for 10% better. We're building for 10x, and then 100x. That ambition sets the standard for everything we do, and everyone we hire.
  
  
So this is for people who want to drive transformation, not wait for it. Restless. Ambitious. More interested in building the engine than operating one someone else designed. If that sounds like you, this is a rare moment to join Euromonitor, and something special to be part of.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The
**Demand Marketing Lead, UK,**
is a key driver of revenue growth in the UK market, accountable for the leads and opportunities generated, the pipeline created, and the revenue closed. This is a hands-on, target-holding role: running an always-on demand generation programme tailored to the UK, tailoring global campaigns and initiatives for regional impact, and developing the local initiatives this market specifically needs.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Act as a key driver of revenue growth in the UK market, accountable for the leads and opportunities generated, the pipeline created, and the revenue closed.
* Run an always-on UK demand generation programme, covering campaigns, lead nurture and regional initiatives.
* Take global campaigns and initiatives and tailor them for the UK market to drive engagement and ROI.
* Identify opportunities specific to the UK market and develop initiatives to go after them, such as local events, partnerships and competitive responses.
* Partner closely with local sales teams on hand-off criteria, pipeline reviews, forecasting and lead scoring and qualification.
* Work with centralized marketing automation, CRM and paid media teams to brief and guide regional execution, rather than running these platforms directly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* UK pipeline and closed-won revenue targets consistently met or exceeded, in partnership with the local sales team.
* Global campaigns land with strong engagement and ROI once tailored for the UK market.
* UK-specific initiatives make a measurable contribution to pipeline, beyond centrally run programmes alone.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years' experience in demand generation or performance marketing, ideally including experience holding a personal revenue or pipeline target.
* All experience must be in B2B marketing. A B2C-only background won't fit this role.
* Has personally held and delivered against a revenue target before, not just a lead or activity target.
* Comfortable partnering closely with local sales teams on hand-off, forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Track record of tailoring national or global campaigns for a specific market, with a clear focus on ROI.
* Confident briefing and directing centralized marketing automation, CRM and paid media specialists, even without running those platforms hands-on day to day.
* Some experience working with AI, whether in a professional role or through personal projects, is something we look for in every hire joining Euromonitor Marketing right now.

**Benefits**
**Why work for Euromonitor?**
**Our Values:**

* We seek individuals who act with integrity
* We look for candidates who are curious about the world
* We feel that as a community, we're stronger together
* We seek to enable people to feel empowered
* We welcome candidates who bring strength in diversity

**International:**
not only do we have a very multinational workforce in each office but we communicate across our 16 offices worldwide on a daily basis.
  
  
**Hardworking and sociable:**
our staff know how to work hard and know also how to enjoy themselves! We pride ourselves on creating an appropriate work-life balance, with flexible hours and regular socialising including frequent after work meet ups, summer and Christmas parties and a whole range of other groups to be involved with.
  
  
**Committed to making a difference:**
We believe that people are looking for something worthwhile in a company beyond the workplace. Our extensive Corporate Social Responsibility Programme gives each member of staff two volunteering days a year in addition to holidays. It gives all new starters a donation amount on joining us which they can give to a charity of their choice.
  
  
It sees us reaching out into the local community with our mentoring, group volunteering, and fundraising initiatives as well as supporting international charities through our website sales, matching staff sponsorship fundraising, and carbon offsetting all our flights.
  
  
**Excellent benefits:**
we offer competitive salaries, enhanced healthcare and pensions, plus generous holiday allowances, hybrid working and, in many offices, a Core Hours policy allowing flexible start and finish times to each day.
  
  
**Opportunities to grow:**
we offer extensive training and development opportunities at all levels. The vast majority of our Managers and Directors have been promoted from within and many have moved across departments as well as upwards. We pride ourselves on identifying and rewarding talent.

We build employer brands to guide the best in the biz into their dream career with our clients.  
We’re a home for people who think big and expect more. We transform a company’s employer brand internally and externally and change cultures from the ground up.
  
  
With creative, strategic and early talent experts in-house, our clients have a single partnership with Wiser and we deliver end to end campaigns helping them to attract and retain the best talent globally.

**What's this role all about?**  
  
Our award-winning Campaigns team at Wiser is scaling fast, launching recruitment marketing campaigns across the globe for some of the world’s biggest brands.

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you'll own the why behind recruitment marketing and employer branding campaigns for some of our biggest global clients. You'll lead campaigns from brief to sign-off: setting the strategy and objectives, shaping the creative, holding teams to account and turning the results into a story clients act on.

You'll work alongside our Media specialists, who plan, build and optimise the media, as well as our Creative, Research, Strategy and Accounts teams.

##### **What will you spend your time doing?**

* Owning campaigns for global clients from brief to sign-off, and being the client's go-to person for your campaigns
* Setting campaign strategy and objectives, grounded in audience insight and the roles the client needs to fill
* Briefing and steering our Creative teams, and pushing the work until it's right for the audience and the platform
* Working closely with the Media team, from shaping the brief to sense-checking plans and builds before anything goes live, so the media delivers what the campaign needs
* Signing off performance reports and presenting them to clients, turning data into clear insights and next steps
* Scoping the work and keeping it on plan and on budget, with timings, approvals and hours tracked
* Growing your accounts by spotting the next phase, market or test, and scoping it into something the client wants to buy
* Supporting pitches and new business with campaign thinking where needed

Unity’s Grow business empowers developers and publishers to build profitable and scalable applications through AI/ML-powered user acquisition, monetization, and engagement tools. With products including Unity Ads that leverages Unity Vector, the AI foundation for user acquisition, alongside LevelPlay mediation and Tapjoy Offerwall, the Grow platform reaches billions of users across the mobile app ecosystem and plays a critical role in Unity’s real-time 3D (RT3D) creator economy.

We’re seeking a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead Go-To-Market for the monetization side of the Grow product suite. You’ll anchor around customer personas and define the positioning, GTM strategy, and product marketing execution. This is a deeply cross-functional role that bridges product value and customer outcomes across gaming and mobile audiences. You’ll partner closely with Product, Sales, and Marketing to align product innovation with go-to-market impact.

* Customer and Persona Segmentation - Define clear, actionable customer personas (e.g., major mobile publishers with multiple titles, indie devs, monetization managers, UA specialists) with distinct needs and use cases. Bring these insights into product design, alpha/beta programs, and strategic briefings.

* Strong business acumen, data literacy, and ability to align product marketing with revenue objectives.
* Experience working with product teams and a track record of influencing roadmap decisions.
* Ability to drive executive/leadership level alignment around GTM planning

**Description**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own Veeqo’s end-to-end product marketing engine. From positioning and messaging, to launch strategy, to adoption, to understanding what resonates with sellers and why.
  
  
In this role, you’ll be the strategic bridge between Product and the market. You’ll ensure every new Veeqo release (from advanced shipping tools to Listings to inventory automation) has a clear value proposition, a defined audience, and a compelling story that drives awareness, activation, and long-term usage.
  
  
You’ll set the standard for product marketing excellence at Veeqo and raise the bar on delivery, collaboration, and seller impact.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Product Marketing Operations & GTM Ownership
* Own how product marketing operates at Veeqo — setting the standard for how we plan, prioritise, and execute launches
* Translate product priorities into clear, actionable GTM plans across Marketing, Product, and Sales
* Ensure every launch has defined goals, target segments, messaging direction, and success metrics
* Drive clarity on what we launch, when, and why — balancing business impact, product readiness, and team capacity
* Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* Act as the central point of alignment between Product, Sales, Lifecycle, and Design
* Proactively manage stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Ensure teams are working towards shared outcomes, not siloed deliverables
* Launch Execution & Delivery Excellence
* Lead end-to-end execution of product launches, ensuring high-quality delivery across all touchpoints
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure launches are delivered on time and to a high standard
* Identify risks early and proactively resolve blockers to maintain momentum
* Ensure launches are outcome-driven — focused on adoption, usage, and revenue impact, not just output
* Building Scalable PMM Mechanisms
* Establish and continuously improve repeatable processes for:
* Launch planning and execution
* Messaging and asset development
* Sales enablement
* Post-launch measurement
* Create clear frameworks, templates, and ways of working that enable the team to scale effectively
* Raise the bar on quality, consistency, and efficiency across all product marketing outputs
* Adoption, Feedback Loops & Continuous Improvement
* Partner with Product and Lifecycle to ensure launches translate into real seller adoption and usage
* Identify gaps in adoption and work cross-functionally to address them
* Establish feedback loops from Sales, Support, and sellers to inform future launches and messaging
* Continuously iterate on GTM approach based on performance and insights
* Sales Enablement & Internal Readiness
* Ensure Sales and Customer-facing teams are equipped with clear, actionable materials for every launch
* Drive consistency in how Veeqo is positioned across internal teams
* Partner with Sales leadership to ensure priority initiatives are effectively rolled out and adopted
* Measurement & Business Impact
* Define and track success metrics for launches and GTM initiatives
* Own reporting on launch performance, adoption, and impact in business reviews
* Use data to inform prioritisation, improve execution, and drive continuous improvement
* Ensure product marketing efforts are clearly tied to measurable business outcomes

**About The Team**
Veeqo is Amazon’s free multi-channel shipping software, used by 100,000 ecommerce sellers to ship orders, sync inventory, and grow across marketplaces. We combine Amazon-level innovation with a fast-moving startup culture.
  
  
We’re building tools that help sellers ship smarter, list products faster, and scale efficiently across all their sales channels. As part of Amazon, we benefit from deep integrations, access to Amazon’s sellers and carrier programs, and a rapidly expanding feature set across shipping, inventory, reporting, listings, and more.
  
  
The Integrated Marketing team uses data, seller insights, and creative experimentation to raise awareness, drive adoption, and help sellers get value quickly. We’re a collaborative group of PMMs, lifecycle marketers, designers, and content specialists who ship fast and learn quickly. You’ll partner closely with the wider Marketing team, Product, Sales, Design, and Amazon orgs to bring new features to market.

* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
* Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
* Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
